shortDescription: Manages host clusters on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cluster_type
options.description: Type of the cluster. Required if I(state=present)

options.name: guest_vswitch_name
options.description: Name of virtual switch used for guest traffic in the cluster. This would override zone wide traffic label setting.

options.name: guest_vswitch_type
options.description: Type of virtual switch used for guest traffic in the cluster. Allowed values are, vmwaresvs (for VMware standard vSwitch) and vmwaredvs (for VMware distributed vSwitch)

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Name the hypervisor to be used. Required if I(state=present). Possible values are C(KVM), C(VMware), C(BareMetal), C(XenServer), C(LXC), C(HyperV), C(UCS), C(OVM), C(Simulator).

options.name: name
options.description: name of the cluster.

options.name: ovm3_cluster
options.description: Ovm3 native OCFS2 clustering enabled for cluster.

options.name: ovm3_pool
options.description: Ovm3 native pooling enabled for cluster.

options.name: ovm3_vip
options.description: Ovm3 vip to use for pool (and cluster).

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the cluster.

options.name: pod
options.description: Name of the pod in which the cluster belongs to.

options.name: public_vswitch_name
options.description: Name of virtual switch used for public traffic in the cluster. This would override zone wide traffic label setting.

options.name: public_vswitch_type
options.description: Type of virtual switch used for public traffic in the cluster. Allowed values are, vmwaresvs (for VMware standard vSwitch) and vmwaredvs (for VMware distributed vSwitch)

options.name: state
options.description: State of the cluster.

options.name: url
options.description: URL for the cluster

options.name: username
options.description: Username for the cluster.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vms_ip_address
options.description: IP address of the VSM associated with this cluster.

options.name: vms_password
options.description: Password for the VSM associated with this cluster.

options.name: vms_username
options.description: Username for the VSM associated with this cluster.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the cluster belongs to.
